mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS total_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_count FROM default_dictionary_item WHERE dictionary_type = #{p.type}

SELECT d.id, d.display_name, d.sort_order, d.status, d.parent_id, p.display_name AS parent_name FROM default_dictionary_item d LEFT JOIN default_dictionary_item p ON p.dictionary_type = d.dictionary_type AND p.id = d.parent_id WHERE d.dictionary_type = #{p.type} AND d.id = #{p.id} FOR UPDATE OF d

SELECT d.id, d.display_name, d.sort_order, d.status, d.parent_id, p.display_name AS parent_name FROM default_dictionary_item d LEFT JOIN default_dictionary_item p ON p.dictionary_type = d.dictionary_type AND p.id = d.parent_id WHERE d.dictionary_type = #{p.type} AND (#{p.query} = '' OR lower(d.display_name) LIKE ('%' || lower(#{p.query}) || '%') ESCAPE '\') AND (CAST(#{p.status} AS varchar) IS NULL OR d.status = CAST(#{p.status} AS varchar)) ORDER BY COALESCE(p.sort_order, d.sort_order), COALESCE(p.created_at, d.created_at), COALESCE(p.id, d.id), CASE WHEN d.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.sort_order, d.created_at, d.id LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM default_dictionary_item WHERE dictionary_type = #{p.type} AND (#{p.query} = '' OR lower(display_name) LIKE ('%' || lower(#{p.query}) || '%') ESCAPE '\') AND (CAST(#{p.status} AS varchar) IS NULL OR status = CAST(#{p.status} AS varchar))
SELECT COALESCE(max(sort_order), -10) FROM default_dictionary_item WHERE dictionary_type = #{p.type} AND parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{p.parentId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO default_dictionary_item( id, dictionary_type, stable_key, parent_id, display_name, normalized_name, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{p.id}, #{p.type}, #{p.stableKey}, #{p.parentId}, #{p.displayName}, #{p.normalizedName}, #{p.sortOrder}, 'ACTIVE', #{p.now}, #{p.now})
UPDATE default_dictionary_item SET status = #{p.status}, updated_at = #{p.now} WHERE dictionary_type = #{p.type} AND id = #{p.id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM default_dictionary_item WHERE dictionary_type = 'EXPENSE_CATEGORY' AND parent_id = #{p.id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE default_dictionary_item SET sort_order = #{p.sortOrder}, updated_at = #{p.now} WHERE dictionary_type = #{p.type} AND id = #{p.id}
